bio.text: Leticia Gutierrez is the Democratic nominee for Texas's 9th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having won the March 2026 Democratic primary, according to the Associated Press as reported by FOX 26 Houston.
According to her campaign website, she has lived in the district for 45 years, graduated from Milby High School, and earned a finance degree from the University of St. Thomas.

Her campaign website says she became an advocate for children's health, works alongside elected officials and government agencies on community issues, and that her oldest son chose to serve in the U.S. Army.
